title: Moving to fermatina.com
intro: This app has a new name and a new address. Your progress is saved in this browser under the old address, so it does not move by itself. It takes three steps.
step1: Save your progress to a file.
step3: There, choose “I have a progress file” on the first screen, or go to Settings → Your data → Import.
nothingSaved: Nothing saved here? Then just open fermatina.com.
keepsWorking: This address keeps working, with everything you saved on it.
settingsLine: This app has moved to fermatina.com. Export here, import there.
